## Hardware

| Connect... |   | ...to... | ...using |
|:-----------|:-:|:---------|:---------|
Monitor | &rarr; | Raspberry Pi | HDMI
Monitor | &rarr; | Raspberry Pi | USB, white port
Audio interface | &rarr; | Raspberry Pi | USB, blue port
Audio interface | &rarr; | MIDI keyboard | MIDI cable[^1]
Computer keyboard / mouse | &rarr; | Raspberry Pi | USB, white first, then blue
Raspberry Pi | &rarr; | AC power |
MIDI Keyboard | &rarr; | AC power |
Headphones or speakers | &rarr; | audio interface (preferred) | Wired (preferred)
: Virtual pipe organ on Raspberry Pi hardware setup

## Software

1. Boot Raspberry Pi
2. Turn on keyboard
3. Launch GrandOrgue

## Troubleshooting

1. Verify the correct [audio output](setup.qmd#grandorgue-configuration) is selected
2. If using an audio interface, ensure the [monitor switches and volume knobs](setup.qmd#audio) are set properly

[^1]: Be sure to connect **MIDI OUT** from the keyboard or organ to **MIDI IN** on the audio interface.
